help_text:
owa-graph files - List, upload, download, share OneDrive items

Shortcuts:
  list      List drive items (root or --path; --top)
  download  Download to stdout (--id or --path)
  upload    Upload --file to --path (small files only)
  share     Create share link (--id [--type view|edit] [--scope anonymous|organization])
  delete    Delete --id
  search    Search drive (--q term [--top])

Common flags accepted by every shortcut:
  --pretty   Human-readable output (table for known shapes, indented JSON otherwise)
  --ndjson   Stream collection items one JSON object per line
  --retry    Honor Retry-After once on 429/503
